candidates.reason: Projects the hour before aggregation, preserving BIGINT hour and count types, NULL groups, and duplicate counts. No ordering is imposed.
candidates.sql: WITH hours AS (SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour FROM trips) SELECT hour AS hour, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM hours GROUP BY hour

candidates.reason: Uses window counts and DISTINCT to return one row per hour, including the NULL partition. Preserves BIGINT types and duplicate counts without imposing ordering.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips

candidates.reason: Filters before grouping through a CTE, preserving the exact day predicate, route types, NULL keys, and duplicate counts. No ordering is imposed.
candidates.sql: WITH eligible_routes AS (SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) SELECT pickup AS pickup, dropoff AS dropoff, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM eligible_routes GROUP BY pickup, dropoff

candidates.reason: Uses filtered aggregation and removes groups with no qualifying rows. Preserves the exact date predicate, NULL route groups, route types, and BIGINT counts without imposing ordering.
candidates.sql: SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0
